name: MultiSelect
summary: Choose multiple items from a searchable popup with a compact selection summary.

useWhen: Selecting several values from a collection while keeping the field compact
Searching a longer collection, or clearing or selecting all of it
avoidWhen: Chosen values that must stay visible; use TagSelect
A short list that can stay visible; use CheckboxGroup

obligations: Items have serializable IDs, and the popup filters them by search text.
Keyboard focus stays inside the open popup until it closes on Escape.

behavior: Items have serializable IDs, and the selection is a set of those IDs, or all of them.
The selection is controlled with selectedKeys or left uncontrolled.
The popup filters items by the search text.
Reset clears the selection and Select all selects every item that is not disabled, whether the selection is controlled or not.

Both report the new selection through onSelectionChange, then call onReset or onSelectAll as notifications. Select all reports the all selection. A controlled selection changes only when the application applies the reported selection.
With the all selection, the selection summary counts the items that are not disabled.
MultiSelect is not a native select: it renders no form input and submits nothing.
The application serializes the selected IDs when the form submits.
required adds an asterisk to the label and the hidden text Required to the trigger's description; it does not check that anything is selected.
invalid adds the hidden text Invalid to that description. While invalid is set, errorMessage replaces the description text.
The trigger's aria-describedby lists the hidden status text and the visible description or error message. The trigger itself carries no aria-required or aria-invalid.
Escape closes the popup, returns focus to the trigger, and keeps the selection. When focus is in the search field, the first Escape clears its text instead.
Keyboard focus stays inside the popup while it is open.
The search field's label and placeholder, the Reset, Select all, and Clear search buttons, and the hidden Required and Invalid text use fixed English text.
The label, placeholder, selection summary, and empty-state text come from props.
accessibility: Items have serializable IDs, and the popup filters them by search text.
Keyboard focus stays inside the open popup until it closes on Escape.

requirements.reason: Native dynamic colors do not apply to the React web binding.
Native font metrics do not apply to the React web binding.
